description: Implementation of WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool class managing WebSocket sockets, including request handling, socket allocation, and connection management.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client sockets, handles socket requests, connection pooling, and request queuing.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::ConnectJobDelegate
classes.description: Delegates connection job completion handling for WebSocket socket pool.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::StalledRequest
classes.description: Represents a queued request that is stalled due to socket limits.

methods.name: UnlockEndpoint
methods.description: Unlocks the endpoint lock for a given socket handle.

methods.name: RequestSocket
methods.description: Requests a single WebSocket socket, possibly queuing if limits are reached.

methods.name: RequestSockets
methods.description: Request multiple sockets (not implemented).

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of a socket request (no-op).

methods.name: CancelRequest
methods.description: Cancels a socket request, releasing resources and activating queued requests.

methods.name: ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool.

methods.name: FlushWithError
methods.description: Fails all pending and queued requests with an error.

methods.name: CloseIdleSockets
methods.description: No idle sockets to close.

methods.name: CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: No idle sockets in group to close.

methods.name: IdleSocketCount
methods.description: Returns zero, as no idle sockets are maintained.

methods.name: IdleSocketCountInGroup
methods.description: Returns zero, as no idle sockets are maintained.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state for a socket handle.

methods.name: GetInfoAsValue
methods.description: Returns pool info as a JSON value.

methods.name: HasActiveSocket
methods.description: Not supported for WebSocket pool.

methods.name: IsStalled
methods.description: Checks if there are stalled requests.

methods.name: AddHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: No-op for this class.

methods.name: RemoveHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: No-op for this class.

methods.name: TryHandOutSocket
methods.description: Attempts to hand out a socket after connection attempt.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a connection job.

methods.name: InvokeUserCallbackLater
methods.description: Posts a task to invoke a callback asynchronously.

methods.name: InvokeUserCallback
methods.description: Invokes a callback with the result.

methods.name: ReachedMaxSocketsLimit
methods.description: Checks if socket limit is reached.

methods.name: HandOutSocket
methods.description: Assigns a socket to a handle and updates pool state.

methods.name: AddJob
methods.description: Adds a connection job delegate to pending jobs.

methods.name: DeleteJob
methods.description: Removes a connection job delegate from pending jobs.

methods.name: LookupConnectJob
methods.description: Finds the connect job for a handle.

methods.name: ActivateStalledRequest
methods.description: Activates queued requests if limits allow.

methods.name: DeleteStalledRequest
methods.description: Removes a stalled request from queue.
